news.title: Hurricanes send Flyers to franchise-record 7th straight loss to open season
news.ruTitle: «Харрикейнз» довели «Флайерз» до рекордного для франшизы седьмого поражения подряд на открытии сезона
news.description: — Andrei Svechnikov and Sebastian Aho each had a goal and an assist and the Carolina Hurricanes beat Philadelphia 4-1 on Sunday night, handing the Flyers their franchise-record seventh straight loss to open the season.

news.title: Without Shesterkin, New York Rangers lean on Garand in win
news.ruTitle: Без Шестеркина «Нью-Йорк Рейнджерс» в победе полагаются на Гаранда
news.description: Two days after losing starting goaltender Igor Shesterkin for the season with a knee injury, Dylan Garand, 24, made 19 saves and the New York Rangers defeated the Vancouver Canucks 6-2 on Sunday night at Madison Square Garden, the club's fifth victory.

news.title: Kartye and Cuylle score 2 each as Rangers down Canucks 6-2 in first game since losing Shesterkin

news.title: Kraken overcome Alex Ovechkin's first goal of the season to beat the Capitals 5-3
news.ruTitle: Кракен превзошел первый гол Алекса Овечкина в сезоне и обыграл «Кэпиталз» со счетом 5–3.
news.description: — Jared McCann broke a tie with 5:27 left and the Seattle Kraken overcame NHL career leader Alex Ovechkin's first goal of the season to beat the Washington Capitals 5-3 on Sunday night.
